PeopleReferenceMatch.description: Evidence for one input label, in the same order as the request.

complete.description:
Malformed matching records cannot establish uniqueness. The caller must also
check directory hydration completeness before relying on a single witness.

people.description: At most two distinct witnesses. Two means ambiguous, not a complete candidate list.

name.description: The stored private name; absence must not invent a first-name match from an email local part.

userId.description: Canonical target identity, never the viewer-scoped record id.

oneOf.description: Required secondary-inbox exclusions are not ready.

matches.description: Same length/order as the raw input labels, including duplicates.

policyVersion.description: Matching contract version, shared with person policy capability admission.

PeopleSearch.description:
A ranked window over the current cached directory, not a completeness claim.
Continuations bind membership/owner and context tokens as well as the
publication epoch. Changed eligible data requires restarting the window.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this same account, generation and search policy.

excluded.description: Explicit exclusions, applied before ranking (for example self).

nowMs.description: Retained wire input for older hosts; recent-first order needs no clock.

query.description: Name/explicit-identity input, capped at 512 UTF-8 bytes.

senderDomain.description: Retained wire input for older hosts; policy 5 has no domain boost.

and viewed-first recency. Group DMs do not occupy this slot.

name.description: Visible conversation label, independent of the contact's private name.

PersonHit.description: Fully materialized winning person; neither the cache key nor DM id replaces user_id.

lastInteractionMs.description: User interaction timestamp for non-command surfaces.

matchRank.description: Priority tier; larger ranks precede smaller ones.

name.description: Visible resolved contact name, with local-part email fallback.

score.description: Retained wire field for older hosts; zero under policy 5.

timestampMs.description: Recent-first ordering within a matching tier; identity breaks ties.

PeopleSearchResult.description: Local search can be temporarily unavailable without asserting an empty directory.

oneOf.description: No complete local ranking-context snapshot is published.
Bounded ranked results from the cache snapshot.

nextCursor.description:
Continue after this ranked window. A window may be short when prior
conversation duplicates were skipped; only null proves exhaustion.

policyVersion.description:
Menu-policy contract version; older native binaries may not apply
current matching, exclusions and ranking before their result limit.

AlteredColumn.description: A column whose type an `ALTER COLUMN` changed.

column.description: The column's property definition before the change.

to.description: The type it became, as SQL spells it.

Cell.description:
A cell as fetched. An absent cell is `NULL`; an absent multi-valued cell
is the empty set.

oneOf.description: Text or link.
A number.
A checkbox.
A date-time.
A span from one date-time to another.
The selected option ids; one for single-select columns.
The referenced entity ids; one for single-valued columns.
A table row's own id, the `row_id` column.

DateRange.description:
A span of time from `start` to `end`, both included. A write whose end
comes before its start is refused.

end.description: Where it ends; never before the start.

columns.description: The result columns, in select-list order; empty for writes.

insertedRowIds.description: Rows an `INSERT` created, in statement order for the rows that landed.

readTables.description:
The tables read, so a caller can watch them for changes. Built-in IDs
are UUID-shaped constants, not RFC-versioned UUIDs.

rowIds.description: For a row-shaped result, the row entity id behind each result row.

truncated.description: Whether the read hit [`ROW_CAP`], making aggregates partial.

column.description: The column behind the values, when there is one.

name.description:
The name as the statement would call it: the column's display name,
or `SUM(amount)`.

table.description: For `row_id`, the table whose rows its cells are.

OutcomeKind.description: The value kind of a result column.

oneOf.description: Text or link.
A number, including every aggregate but `MIN`/`MAX` of dates.
A checkbox.
A date-time.
A span from one date-time to another.
Select option ids; the caller labels them from the catalog.
Entity ids; the caller hydrates them.
The `row_id` column: the ids of the table's own rows.

oneOf.description: This storage does not execute SQL. Never replace this with a directory fold.

outcome.description: At most 500 final rows and no directory-sized intermediate relation.
